title: Coordinator for Student Organizations and Resources
bio: I work with all things Student Organizations at Harvard College. I manage the SOCO website, work with student organizations for event planning, and student organization space booking at Hilles. In my free time, I like to read books, hang out with my cat, go to the movie theater, and go to the beach. I am originally from Miami, Florida, so I find great pleasure in maintaining a relaxing presence and living the good life by doing things that bring me joy, such as exploring the city and eating food. Students should reach out to me if they have a question about events, booking space at Hilles, late-night events, or general conflicts happening within the student organization.
